data.long_meaning: In the name Al-Husain, Al is a prefix denoting 'the' in Arabic, and Husain is the name itself. Husain means 'the well-satisfied one'. This name is a reference to Imam Husain ibn Ali, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who was known for his piety, courage, and unwavering commitment to Islam. The name Alhusain carries the meaning “The well-satisfied one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alhusain usually hope their child will grow to embody the well-satisfied one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
